label: omega_baryon
source: PDG 2025 summary tables (pdg.lbl.gov, the Omega- listing; S. Navas et al., Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024) and 2025 update)
rule: The S = -3 ground state: the Omega- (J^P = 3/2+, I = 0) at its listed mass, stable here (its decays Lambda K-, Xi0 pi- and Xi- pi0 are weak, as the Xi's are), with the classes (Omega-, K+) and (Omega-, K0) at the S = -2 excited baryonic continuum of charge 0 and -1 and their conjugates. The excited Omega states list no branching fractions and stay out.
